title: Rav Chanan of Bei Kluchit—Sluchit—Tzluchit
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Rav Papa, his son, appears in [Ketubot 40b](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.40b.12). Hyman writes that perhaps the reading should be “of Bei Kochalit,” which he describes as a city in the Land of Israel, citing [Kiddushin 66a](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.66a.8).[^1]

notes.text: Ketubot has Bei Klochit in the patronymic. Kiddushin describes Kuchlit as being in the desert, which leaves Hyman’s proposed identification open.
